Excellent service and delicious food!
Nov 2025 • Friends
We had the set menu and it was first class - we also had wine and bubbles. The kale salad had a citrus dressing and was delicious. The scallops were perfectly cooked and seasoned. The salmon was amazing. The flavours blended beautifully and every mouthful was enjoyed. The beef was tender and the jus and the mash complemented it perfectly. (This is from a butcher’s daughter!)

The service was wonderful with very attentive staff; the restaurant is an oasis of calm gastronomic delight. 

An absolute pleasure! Thank you!

✨Service Amazing! Great Experience ✨
Nov 2025 • Solo
I’m happy I stopped here! The service was amazing… from beginning to end. My server was so attentive, friendly and helpful. 

The ambiance was perfect. The right amount of lighting, candle lit at the table, music was just right… a nice vibe. 

The food and drink, I got the burger and fries (I’ve been in Vietnam for a great amount of time and wanted something a little different). The food was good, the burger was cooked to my liking, could of used a little more seasoning, but it wasn’t bad. The fries were hot and crisp. I purchased the Ignis Cocktail (Codigo Rosa Tequila) and it has a smoky flavor (which I like), so I loved my drink. 

Overall, a great experience and if you’re in Ho Chi Minh City, you should give it a try. ✨

Happy Hour Menu Scam.
Jun 2025 • Couples
Stay away from this place, service was slow and honestly they didn't even know how to serve, poor a beer correctly. Scam on the menu, given a menu during happy hour, Saigon Special at 79k dong, ecpecting, told it was was happy hour, beer will be half that, instead charged 150k for the beer, then discount, but then plus plus plus plus. Menu disappeared when I questioned the bill. I ll be returning soon with a camera's.
Read more
Written July 3, 2025
Vestapen
Dear Valued Guest,

First and foremost, we sincerely thank you for taking the time to share your experience on Tripadvisor. We are truly sorry to hear that your visit to our restaurant did not meet your expectations.

Regarding the issue of slow service that you mentioned, we have conducted a review of our CCTV footage and serving procedures during your visit. Our checks indicate that the average serving time for drinks is between 2-4 minutes and for food is 12-13 minutes. We believe this is a stable and reasonable service time compared to general standards. However, we understand that customer perception is paramount, and we will continue our efforts to improve service speed.

Regarding the Happy Hour beer pricing, we would like to clarify our pricing method. The price listed on our menu is the original price, and a discount line is then applied to bring the beer price down to the Happy Hour promotional rate of 69,000 VND. The Value Added Tax (VAT) for beer is also calculated based on the discounted Happy Hour price of 69,000 VND, not the original price. We sincerely regret if the presentation on the bill caused any misunderstanding for you.

We are also very sorry for your unsatisfactory experience with how our Blancs staff served the beer. We will seriously review and retrain our team members to ensure that the quality of service always meets our standards and satisfies all our customers.

If you wish to return to review the CCTV footage or require any further information related to this experience, we are always willing to assist. Please feel free to contact us directly for clarification.

We apologize once again for any inconvenience you experienced and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back to provide a much better experience in the future.

Sincerely,
Blanc de Blancs

Deceptive advertising and unacceptable attitude from the owner
Sep 2024 • Friends
Out of all my dining experiences in Ho Chi Minh City, this was by far the most disappointing — and frustrating. What was advertised and what we actually experienced were two completely different things. It felt misleading from the start.

Things got worse when I asked to speak to the manager, and was introduced to someone I believe is the owner — a woman named Maria. Sadly, her attitude was shockingly dismissive and unprofessional. She showed no willingness to listen or resolve the issue, and instead treated us in a way that felt condescending and disrespectful.

I brought my friends here hoping for a pleasant evening, but it turned into something we all wish we could forget. Every single one of us walked away feeling frustrated, disappointed, and deeply regretful about choosing this place.

If you're considering Blanc de Blancs, I strongly urge you to think twice. There are many far better — and far more honest — places in Saigon where your time, money, and trust will actually be respected.
